# Packages

62 workspace packages. Roles are derived: `camstack.system: true` →
framework; a `camstack.addons[]` entry → addon; `server/*` → the root app;
everything else → tooling.

## App (1)

The single root package every node boots. Hub vs agent is `CAMSTACK_ROLE`, not a different package.

| Package | Directory | Version | Reaches a node via | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@camstack/server` | `server/backend` | 1.2.653 | the update itself | — |

## Framework (5)

Host-provided: addons do NOT bundle these, they resolve them from the running closure. Consequence worth knowing: a framework change reaches a node ONLY through a root-package install (`applyServerUpdate` / "Update all"), pinned to the exact version the published `@camstack/server` carries. `camstack deploy` cannot ship it.

| Package | Directory | Version | Reaches a node via | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@camstack/develop` | `packages/develop` | 0.1.36 | `@camstack/server` closure | CamStack developer tooling — catalogue, scaffold, validate, and example lookup shared by the CLI and MCP server. |
| `@camstack/sdk` | `packages/sdk` | 1.2.153 | `@camstack/server` closure | — |
| `@camstack/system` | `packages/system` | 1.2.493 | `@camstack/server` closure | Core addon for CamStack — builtins, pipeline, process management, auth, logging, events |
| `@camstack/types` | `packages/types` | 1.2.425 | `@camstack/server` closure | Shared types, interfaces, and model catalogs for the CamStack detection ecosystem |
| `@camstack/ui-library` | `packages/ui-library` | 1.2.335 | `@camstack/server` closure | — |

## Addons (49)

Each declares one or more `camstack.addons[]` entries and lives in `<dataDir>/addons/`. Updated with `camstack deploy` (or the Addons page) — NOT by a root-package update. The ones marked _image-seeded_ are also dependencies of the root package: the image copies them into the addons dir on first boot, after which the addons-dir copy is what loads and the closure copy is inert.
